name: repo-reaper
description: Cut repository bloat by questioning whether each document, rule, plan, skill, or file needs to exist. Reviews drafted plans for over-engineering and checks slimmed projects for regrowth.

interface.shortDescription: Cut repository bloat and over-engineered plans.
interface.longDescription: Questions whether each document, rule, plan, skill, or file serves the project's core goal and has an owner, proposes deletions for your approval, and deletes only what Git can restore. Also reviews a drafted plan for over-engineering before implementation, and checks a slimmed project for regrowth.
defaultPrompt: Slim down the docs and rules in this repository
Review the plan you just drafted for over-engineering
